description: Cross-country benchmark metrics — 10 OECD peer countries

social_mobility_ige.note: High earnings persistence; inter-generational mobility below OECD avg
social_mobility_ige.source: OECD Social Mobility for Inclusive Growth 2023

top_policy_reforms.description: Merged six legacy benefits into one; improved work-incentives by smoothing taper rate; reduced welfare trap for low-income earners.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Employment rate rose to record highs pre-pandemic; marginal effective tax rate on benefits reduced.
top_policy_reforms.source: OECD Economic Survey of the UK 2023; DWP evaluation

top_policy_reforms.reform: Bank of England independence & post-GFC macro-prudential framework (2008–2014)
top_policy_reforms.description: Creation of Financial Policy Committee; stress-testing regime; higher capital buffers prevented second banking collapse.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Financial sector stabilised after 2008; UK avoided full bank nationalisation beyond RBS/HBOS.
top_policy_reforms.source: OECD Economic Survey of the UK 2010; Bank of England Financial Stability Reports

top_policy_reforms.reform: North Sea oil fiscal regime reform & Hinkley / energy diversification (2012–2024)
top_policy_reforms.description: Reform of petroleum revenue tax; commitment to renewable energy targets under CfD auctions; offshore wind scale-up.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: UK became global leader in offshore wind; energy security improved; green industrial strategy emerged.
top_policy_reforms.source: OECD Economic Survey of the UK 2022

social_mobility_ige.note: Highest social mobility in OECD; strong education & welfare system
social_mobility_ige.source: OECD Social Mobility for Inclusive Growth 2023

top_policy_reforms.description: Extension of flexicurity — easy hiring/firing combined with generous unemployment benefits and active labour market policies (ALMPs).
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Unemployment stayed below 6% even through the Global Financial Crisis; one of the highest employment rates in the OECD.

top_policy_reforms.reform: Pension reform — transition from defined-benefit to DC + mandatory labour market pensions (1987–2010)
top_policy_reforms.description: Gradual shift to funded ATP / occupational pensions; increased private savings rate substantially.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Pension assets ~200% of GDP; sustainable public finances; reduced pressure on PAYG state pension.

top_policy_reforms.reform: 2011 tax reform — shift from income to consumption taxes
top_policy_reforms.description: Reduced marginal income tax rates; offset by higher environmental and property taxes; revenue-neutral.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Improved labour supply incentives; Denmark remained highest-taxing OECD country with strong growth.

social_mobility_ige.note: Second highest mobility; strong vocational education (MBO/HBO)
social_mobility_ige.source: OECD Social Mobility for Inclusive Growth 2023

top_policy_reforms.reform: Wassenaar Agreement legacy & wage moderation framework (2010s)
top_policy_reforms.description: Building on 1982 Wassenaar, tripartite wage restraint agreements kept unit labour costs competitive; reinforced during sovereign debt crisis.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Netherlands avoided severe competitiveness losses; maintained current account surplus; export growth.

top_policy_reforms.description: Replaced state insurance monopoly with regulated private competition; mandatory universal basic insurance; risk-equalisation fund.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Universal coverage achieved; cost-efficiency improved; widely cited as model for market-based universal healthcare.

top_policy_reforms.description: Tightening of mortgage interest deduction; introduction of social housing means-testing; gradual pension age increase to 67.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Housing market stabilised after bubble; pension sustainability improved; fiscal consolidation achieved.

social_mobility_ige.note: Moderate mobility; dual apprenticeship system aids transitions
social_mobility_ige.source: OECD Social Mobility for Inclusive Growth 2023

top_policy_reforms.description: Four-stage reform: tightened job-search conditionality, merged unemployment assistance and social aid (Hartz IV), expanded temporary work agencies, created mini-job categories.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Unemployment fell from ~11% (2005) to ~3% (2019); 'German jobs miracle'; real wage growth initially suppressed but recovered.

top_policy_reforms.description: Renewable Energy Act (EEG) 2000 set feed-in tariffs; subsequent reforms moved to auction-based CfDs; phase-out of nuclear (completed 2023).
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Renewable share of electricity ~55% by 2023; created global export industries in solar, wind technology; energy costs initially raised.

top_policy_reforms.description: Solidarity surcharge financed eastern reconstruction; Schuldenbremse (debt brake) constitutionalised from 2009; structural surplus achieved by 2014.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Eastern productivity convergence (still incomplete); constitutional fiscal discipline; debt fell from ~80% to ~60% GDP pre-pandemic.

public_debt_pct_gdp.source: Singapore MOF (Govt securities, largely offset by assets)

social_mobility_ige.note: Strong mobility via meritocratic education; Gini limits bottom decile
social_mobility_ige.source: Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy / World Bank estimate

top_policy_reforms.description: Government-funded S$500 credit per adult for training; sectoral workforce transformation programmes; Earn & Learn pathways.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Adult participation in training rose to among highest in Asia; productivity growth accelerated; economy pivoted toward high-value services.

top_policy_reforms.reform: Economic restructuring from manufacturing to services hub (1997–2010)
top_policy_reforms.description: Deliberate shift from labour-intensive manufacturing toward finance, biomedical, ICT; attracted MNC regional HQs via tax incentives and IP regime.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: GDP per capita overtook most G7 nations; Singapore became top global financial centre alongside London/New York.

top_policy_reforms.reform: Medisave / MediShield Life healthcare financing reform (2015)
top_policy_reforms.description: Expanded mandatory health savings (Medisave) and universal catastrophic insurance (MediShield Life); added Pioneer Generation subsidies.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Universal health coverage achieved at low cost; out-of-pocket spending remains high but financial risk protection improved.

social_mobility_ige.note: Declining mobility; education arms race (hagwons) limits equalisation
social_mobility_ige.source: OECD Social Mobility for Inclusive Growth 2023

top_policy_reforms.description: IMF-supported restructuring of chaebols; bank recapitalisation; NPL resolution; corporate governance reform (boards, minority shareholder rights).
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Korea recovered in two years — fastest post-AFC recovery; fiscal consolidation with surplus by 2000; chaebol leverage reduced.

top_policy_reforms.reform: National pension system and social insurance expansion (1999–2008)
top_policy_reforms.description: Extension of National Pension Scheme to all workers; expansion of employment insurance and industrial accident insurance.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Social safety net coverage expanded; elderly poverty still high but trending down; pension fund became global sovereign investor.

top_policy_reforms.description: Government-funded national broadband rollout; 'Informatisation' strategy; IT-cluster development in Pangyo.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Korea became world leader in broadband penetration; ICT sector ~10% of GDP; Samsung/SK Hynix global semiconductor champions.

social_mobility_ige.note: Moderate mobility; strong tertiary attainment aids upward mobility
social_mobility_ige.source: OECD Social Mobility for Inclusive Growth 2023

top_policy_reforms.description: 12.5% corporate tax rate; IDA Ireland targeted MNC investment; IP-friendly Knowledge Development Box; skilled English-speaking labour.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Ireland hosts EU HQs of Google, Apple, Meta, Pfizer, Medtronic; corporate tax receipts >€24bn (2023); GDP/GNI distortion acknowledged.

top_policy_reforms.reform: Post-GFC fiscal consolidation & banking sector restructuring (2010–2015)
top_policy_reforms.description: €67bn IMF/EU bailout; NAMA bad bank created; five bank recapitalisations; €30bn fiscal consolidation over 6 years; water charges controversy.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Ireland exited programme 2013 — fastest euro area recovery; primary surplus by 2014; 10yr bond yields normalised by 2015.

top_policy_reforms.description: Housing For All plan (2021): 33,000 homes/year target; First Home shared equity; NDP capital investment; National Childcare Scheme expansion.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Housing supply increased (though still insufficient); childcare affordability improved significantly; female labour force participation rising.

social_mobility_ige.note: High mobility; skills-based immigration raises average earnings
social_mobility_ige.source: OECD Social Mobility for Inclusive Growth 2023

top_policy_reforms.reform: Inflation targeting & Bank of Canada framework (1991–present)
top_policy_reforms.description: Canada was first major economy to adopt explicit 2% inflation target; 5-year renewable agreement between Finance and BoC; flexible exchange rate.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Inflation remained in 1-3% band for three decades; monetary credibility enabled aggressive stimulus in 2020; fiscal-monetary coordination during COVID.

top_policy_reforms.description: Federal Skilled Worker Programme reform; Express Entry system (2015) — online pool with rank-based draws; provincial nominee programmes.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Canada admitted highest per-capita skilled immigrants in OECD; productivity spillovers from immigrant entrepreneurs; population ageing partially offset.

top_policy_reforms.description: Finance Minister Martin's 1994 budget: 20% programme spending cuts; federal transfers to provinces reduced; balanced-budget legislation enacted.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Federal deficit eliminated by 1997; debt fell from 67% to 28% of GDP by 2008; 'Canadian fiscal miracle' widely cited internationally.

social_mobility_ige.note: Above-average mobility; strong VET system and universal healthcare
social_mobility_ige.source: OECD Social Mobility for Inclusive Growth 2023

top_policy_reforms.description: Floating AUD; financial deregulation; tariff reduction; enterprise bargaining; privatisation of Qantas, Commonwealth Bank, Telstra; compulsory superannuation (1992).
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Record 27-year recession-free growth (1991–2020); productivity growth accelerated through 1990s; superannuation assets now >AUD 3.5tn.

top_policy_reforms.reform: Mining boom revenue management & sovereign wealth fund (2004–2013)
top_policy_reforms.description: Future Fund established 2006; resource super profits tax debate; stimulus package (2008) credited with avoiding recession; infrastructure investment.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Australia was only OECD economy to avoid GFC recession; Future Fund assets >AUD 200bn; fiscal surpluses during boom years.

top_policy_reforms.description: Universal insurance model replacing fragmented state services for disability; individualised funding packages; choice and control for participants.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: 600,000+ Australians receiving support by 2024; labour market participation for people with disability increased; significant fiscal cost (~AUD 44bn/yr).

social_mobility_ige.note: High mobility; comprehensive welfare + free university education
social_mobility_ige.source: OECD Social Mobility for Inclusive Growth 2023

top_policy_reforms.description: Bank nationalisation and good-bank/bad-bank resolution; fiscal consolidation of 11% GDP; inflation targeting adopted; pension reform initiated.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Sweden's 'model' crisis resolution — banks sold back to market within years; fiscal surplus by 1997; widely cited as template for Ireland 2010.

top_policy_reforms.description: Replaced PAYG DB pension with income-linked notional accounts + funded premium pension; automatic balancing mechanism links benefits to longevity/growth.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Pension system among most fiscally sustainable in OECD; incentivises longer working lives; model adopted by Norway, Poland, Italy.

top_policy_reforms.reform: School voucher system & free school reform (1992–present)
top_policy_reforms.description: Universal school choice introduced; public funding follows student to private/municipal schools; significant expansion of independent ('friskola') sector.
top_policy_reforms.outcome: Increased parental choice; mixed PISA outcomes (initial gains, later stagnation); ongoing debate on segregation; vocational tracks remain strong.
